name: email
description:
JVS type for an email message. Extends sysobject so the inherited title (core_mls) + body (core_mls) fields carry the subject and body preview respectively — every mls entry then gets the full enrichment surface (clean, segmented, pos, segmented_ner) when the jvs-enrich step runs.

Adds email-specific top-level fields on top of what sysobject provides:
  · sender_address / sender_name / sender_domain — the RFC 822 sender
  · recipient_count                                — number of To/Cc/Bcc addresses (denormalised from the Envelope Index)
  · mailbox_url                                    — imap://... / mbox: / etc.
  · read / flagged                                 — user state
  · size_bytes                                     — full message size on disk
  · is_newsletter                                  — list-shaped heuristic (see mail-register.yaml Groovy step)

To add another field: append to `fields[]` below. Choose a core type (core_string / core_long / core_boolean / core_url / core_mls / core_date) and — if you want the field to be searchable — declare it under groups: with the appropriate method:
  · identifier — exact-match StringField (best for domains, email addresses, IDs)
  · text       — analyzed TextField (best for free-text values that should tokenise)
  · long       — LongPoint + numeric doc values (best for range queries + sort)
  · date       — date-parsed (looks up parser via typesystem)

Don't put subject or body preview here as scalar fields — they come from the inherited sysobject.title / sysobject.body (both core_mls, so the enrichment pipeline populates .clean / .segmented / .pos / .segmented_ner on each mls entry).
